apps/web/src/app/dashboard/suppliers/pag: Badge colour band, green above 90% on-time and amber below. No money moves on it and no server disagrees with it — the rate itself comes from the API and is printed beside the badge.
apps/web/src/app/hq/webhooks/page.tsx de: Badge colour band for webhook delivery health. Presentation of a number the API sends; nothing is priced, paid or charged from it.
apps/web/src/lib/dictionaries/en/dashboa: Presentation. An input-format example ("mis. -2000 untuk potongan Rp2.000") teaching the field how to be typed, not quoting a rule.
apps/web/src/lib/dictionaries/en/help.ts: LIVE BUSINESS NUMBER, not presentation. The points earn rate is the per-depot `earnRateRupiah` tunable — /dashboard/loyalist already reads it and interpolates it. This customer FAQ hardcodes Rp 1.000, so a depot that changes the rate leaves this sentence lying. Allowlisted to record it, not to excuse it: fixing it needs the setting fetched on the help screen.
apps/web/src/lib/dictionaries/en/hq.ts R: LIVE BUSINESS NUMBER. Third copy of `earnRateRupiah`, this one on the HQ loyalty screen, which is the screen that EDITS the setting — so it can contradict the field directly above it.
LIVE BUSINESS NUMBER. This is REFUND_HQ_THRESHOLD (payment-service config, DEFAULT_REFUND_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD). Change the config and this subtitle keeps quoting Rp 100rb.
apps/web/src/lib/dictionaries/en/hq.ts r: Score weights (70/30), not rupiah — the money regex matched `revenue + 30`. Still a business constant living in copy; low drift risk because the composite score is presentational.
apps/web/src/lib/dictionaries/en/hrFix.t: Presentation. Placeholder text for a free-form note field, illustrating what a note looks like.
LIVE BUSINESS NUMBER. The over-deposit threshold that decides whether a note is mandatory. Copy and rule can drift apart with nobody noticing.
